claims.text: Section 12.2 is a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages: neither party is liable for indirect, special, incidental, exemplary, punitive or consequential damages, including lost profits, lost revenues or lost savings.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT WILL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL, EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES OF ANY KIND, INCLUDING ANY LOST PROFITS, LOST REVENUES OR LOST SAVINGS

claims.text: The exclusion applies whether the claim is in contract, tort, strict liability or otherwise, and even if the party was advised of or should have known of the possibility of such damages.

citations.quote: WHETHER IN CONTRACT, TORT, STRICT LIABILITY OR OTHERWISE, EVEN IF THE PARTY HAS BEEN ADVISED, KNOWS OR SHOULD KNOW, OR IS OTHERWISE AWARE OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES

claims.text: The exclusion does not apply to claims made under the indemnity in Section 12.1, which is the carve-out from the exclusion.

citations.quote: EXCEPTING ONLY CLAIMS MADE PURSUANT TO SECTION 12.1

claims.text: Section 12.1 is a mutual indemnity covering third-party claims based on, among other things, the indemnitor's breach of any obligation, warranty, representation or covenant in the Agreement, personal injury or property damage caused by the indemnitor's fault or negligence, and third-party infringement claims.

citations.quote: (a) a claim of a failure to perform, or a breach by Indemnitor of, any obligation, warranty, representation or covenant in this Agreement; (b) a claim of personal injury or property damage arising out of the fault or negligence of Indemnitor, its representatives, agents, or employees; or (c) a claim of infringement or misappropriation of any patent, trademark, copyright or other proprietary right held by any third party
